newsitem.title: USA: Sigma-Aldrich to open U.S., U.K. plants.
newsitem.headline: Sigma-Aldrich to open U.S., U.K. plants.

text.p: Sigma-Aldrich Corp said Thursday it will open new plants later this year in the United States and the United Kingdom to enhance the worldwide expansion of its chemical businesses.
In the United States, new facilities and equipment will support the growing demand for its metal products.
The company did not say where the plants will be located.

It said slow growth in government research funding, strong market competition and currency pressures will continue to have an effect on its business, though current investments should assure its long-term growth.

Sigma-Aldrich, which manufactures biochemicals, organic chemicals and diagnostic reagents, earlier reported first-quarter earnings rose to $41.4 million or $0.41 per share, up from $36.7 million, or $0.37 per share a year ago.
